mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM research_stat_snapshot s JOIN research_prepared_snapshot p ON p.snapshot_id=s.id ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT s.* FROM research_stat_snapshot s JOIN research_prepared_snapshot p ON p.snapshot_id=s.id WHERE s.status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN d.record_kind='RESOURCE' THEN d.document_key WHEN COALESCE(d.pmid,i.pmid) IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('P:',COALESCE(d.pmid,i.pmid)) ELSE d.document_key END
research_prepared_document d LEFT JOIN research_prepared_identity i ON i.revision=#{q.revision} AND i.doi=d.doi

choose.when: AND IN ( SELECT canonical_key FROM (SELECT canonical_key,MIN(y.stat_year) chosen_year FROM JOIN research_prepared_year y ON y.document_id=d.id WHERE GROUP BY canonical_key) years WHERE chosen_year=#{q.memberKey})

choose.otherwise: SELECT m.member_key dimension_key,MIN(m.display_name) display_name,MIN(m.author_name) author_name,MIN(m.institution_name) institution_name,COUNT(DISTINCT ) publication_count FROM JOIN ${table} m ON m.document_id=d.id WHERE GROUP BY m.member_key ORDER BY publication_count DESC,display_name ASC,m.member_key ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT canonical_key publication_key,MIN(record_kind) record_kind,MIN(resource_accession) resource_accession,MIN(source_url) source_url,MIN(source_url) resource_url, MIN(pmid) pmid,MIN(doi) doi,MIN(title) title,MIN(pub_year) pub_year,MIN(journal_title) journal_title, MIN(gsa_accessions) gsa_accessions,MIN(bioproject_accession) bioproject_accession, GROUP_CONCAT(source_code ORDER BY source_code) source_codes,JSON_OBJECTAGG(source_code,source_key) source_record_keys FROM ( SELECT canonical_key,d.source_code,MIN(d.source_key) source_key,MIN(d.record_kind) record_kind,MIN(d.resource_accession) resource_accession,MIN(d.source_url) source_url, MIN(d.pmid) pmid,MIN(d.doi) doi,MIN(d.title) title,MIN(d.pub_year) pub_year,MIN(d.journal_title) journal_title,MIN(d.gsa_accessions) gsa_accessions,MIN(d.bioproject_accession) bioproject_accession FROM JOIN ${table} m ON m.document_id=d.id WHERE GROUP BY canonical_key,d.source_code ) sources GROUP BY canonical_key ORDER BY canonical_key LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
